wstep: There is no recipe here for raw red deer or roe deer loin that is aged or cured dry and eaten without cooking.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to the EU, freezing under the recommended conditions kills parasites, but some Trichinella species found in game animals and horses are resistant to it.
In the EU, meat from horses, wild game and other animals that could carry Trichinella must be examined for this parasite.
NCHFP says it is best not to make jerky from game meat soiled by gut contents, and to use such meat only in ways that it will be thoroughly cooked.
